name: CA Engagement Status Summary
query:
select
  e.status as "Status:Data:150",
  t.service_line as "Service Line:Data:200",
  count(*) as "Engagements:Int:120",
  sum(e.budgeted_hours_total) as "Budgeted Hours:Float:150",
  sum(e.actual_hours_total) as "Actual Hours:Float:150"
from `tabCA Engagement` e
left join `tabCA Engagement Type Template` t on t.name = e.engagement_type_template
where e.docstatus < 2
group by e.status, t.service_line
order by e.status

name: CA Open Rule Flags
query:
select
  name as "Rule Flag:Link/CA Rule Flag:150",
  engagement as "Engagement:Link/CA Engagement:150",
  financial_statement as "Financial Statement:Link/CA Financial Statement:180",
  severity as "Severity:Data:120",
  rule_source as "Source:Data:220",
  description as "Description:Data:320",
  raised_by as "Raised By:Link/User:150",
  raised_on as "Raised On:Date:100"
from `tabCA Rule Flag`
where status = 'Open'
order by field(severity, 'Breach', 'Judgment Required', 'Disclosure Gap', 'Observation'), raised_on

name: CA Staff Workload
query:
select
  t.assigned_to as "Staff:Link/User:180",
  t.engagement as "Engagement:Link/CA Engagement:150",
  count(*) as "Open Tasks:Int:110",
  sum(t.budgeted_hours) as "Budgeted Hours:Float:140",
  sum(t.actual_hours) as "Actual Hours:Float:140",
  sum(case when t.over_budget = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as "Over Budget Tasks:Int:150"
from `tabCA Engagement Task` t
where t.status != 'Cleared' and t.assigned_to is not null
group by t.assigned_to, t.engagement
order by t.assigned_to

name: CA WIP Summary by Engagement
query:
select
  engagement as "Engagement:Link/CA Engagement:150",
  sum(hours) as "Total Hours:Float:120",
  sum(billable_value) as "Billable Value:Currency:150",
  sum(case when billed = 0 then billable_value else 0 end) as "Unbilled Value:Currency:150",
  sum(case when billed = 1 then billable_value else 0 end) as "Billed Value:Currency:150"
from `tabCA WIP Entry`
group by engagement
order by engagement

name: CA QCR Findings Register
query:
select
  r.name as "QCR Review:Link/CA QCR Review:150",
  r.engagement as "Engagement:Link/CA Engagement:150",
  r.qcr_reviewer as "Reviewer:Link/User:150",
  r.overall_rating as "Overall Rating:Data:220",
  f.finding_area as "Area:Data:180",
  f.finding as "Finding:Data:320",
  f.severity as "Severity:Data:100"
from `tabCA QCR Review` r
inner join `tabCA QCR Finding` f on f.parent = r.name
order by r.review_date desc

name: CA Checklist Completion
query:
select
  name as "Checklist:Link/CA Engagement Checklist:150",
  engagement as "Engagement:Link/CA Engagement:150",
  total_items as "Total Items:Int:100",
  completed_items as "Completed:Int:100",
  percent_complete as "% Complete:Percent:120"
from `tabCA Engagement Checklist`
order by percent_complete asc
